none: PAS SUSS-3513F2: Roman Coin: Radiate of Carausius
contea di ritrovamento: East Sussex (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman radiate coin of Carausius (AD 286-293) (Reece Period 14), The reverse legend is illegible, with unclear male figure advancing left (possibly the emperor on a SAECVLI FELICITAS issue). Obverse legend reads: CARAVS[IVS] [...]. Mint unclear. The surface of the coin is extremely worn. Some circumferential losses are evident, in addition to surface wear.
